# `unauthorized`

**Type:** `https://docs.cafaye.com/errors/unauthorized`

**HTTP status:** `401`

**Title:** `Unauthorized`

A reserved code. The status is fixed at 401 by the contract, so a client that sees this code can act on the status without reading further.

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "https://docs.cafaye.com/errors/unauthorized",
  "title": "Unauthorized",
  "status": 401,
  "detail": "an example unauthorized response",
  "instance": "/v1/example",
  "code": "unauthorized",
  "trace_id": "0af7651916cd43dd8448eb211c80319c"
}
```

## Stability

Contract infrastructure — this URI is permanent. PLAN §1 stability rule 2 / DECISIONS.md MD30 exempts `docs.cafaye.com/errors/<code>` from every docs redesign and path rewrite: a client may store this URI and dereference it years later. The only permitted change is the addition of a new `<code>`.

See also: [the error contract index](/errors/) and [core's OpenAPI conventions](https://github.com/cafaye/core/blob/master/docs/openapi-conventions.md).
